provenanceRequirement: Explicit manifest plus an expected SHA256 obtained from an independent delivery audit; matching report build/source/version declarations. A schema check alone never establishes provenance.
reviewPoints: One explicitly selected report path; no Downloads scan or credential/pairing-record lookup.
Strict deep report field whitelists, duplicate-key/non-finite rejection, 64 KiB limit, exact bool/int handling and fixed false flags.
Counts preserve actual first-overflow values 9 and 33, and one in-flight TCP attempt during global timeout or cancellation.
Phase/outcome/count/attempt ordering follows the current state machine; no speculative permission, VPN, peer identity or renewal conclusions.
Unavailable/invalid/digest-mismatched manifest remains schema-only; a valid mismatched build/source/version manifest is rejected.
An external digest is a caller trust input. Its independent origin and actual device/delivery history are not attested by this tool.
JSON exponent overflow such as 1e400 is rejected by the parser, in addition to NaN/Infinity literals and invalid elapsed fields.

rootIndependentReview.scope: Main validation branches and compatibility with the actual build-11 manifest shape
rootIndependentReview.subsequentChange: Explicit non-finite JSON exponent rejection, covered by the final passing synthetic suite
